text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see! A "Synergy Project" designed to 
maintain team motivation...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I would appreciate it if you could 
help spread the word as part of my 
activities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompanied Casino Drive as an 
associate for press coverage related to 
her project.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
My, how marvelous. To think you were 
moving forward with a new project on top 
of taking on the world!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Precisely because it is a difficult 
challenge, fostering a positive team 
atmosphere is essential.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That's why I focused on "taking a 
breather." If our members can build a 
relationship where they can enjoy 
themselves and relax together—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Even the greatest walls can be overcome by 
supporting each other. That is truly the 
key to achieving a big dream.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you truly care about your 
members! Casino-san, your personal 
relationships must surely be incredibly 
fulfilling as well!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
For example, are you still in touch with 
the schoolmates you had back in America? 
Or perhaps――
choice_data_list:
Um, wasn't today's interview supposed to 
be about the project...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――Fufu, of course social connections are 
important. However, what matters is not 
who I associate with.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Who I connect with whom. When managing a 
team, this sense of purpose is 
indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Once the objective is set, the necessary 
actions can be determined. Shall we 
discuss the behavioral methodology for 
team management as well?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please pardon me! I just assumed that 
coming from you, Casino, we'd get to hear 
about your fabulous circle of friends!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Maybe about your family! 
Casino, you have two older sisters, right?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ........ ――Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Consecutive GⅠ titles together! A glorious 
achievement! I'm sure Casino must be 
terribly proud!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us more about that? ――How 
you felt, surrounded by such exceptional 
elder sisters!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
choice_data_list:
――! Excuse me, that's all for the 
interview!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. For showing you such a 
pathetic side of myself...
choice_data_list:
...You just overstepped a bit, it couldn't 
be helped.

...You just overstepped a bit, it couldn't 
be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bringing up sisters had clearly changed 
her demeanor. I hesitated to press the 
issue... but I couldn't help but worry.
choice_data_list:
......Um, by that older girl, do you 
meanââ

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...It's not that we're on bad terms at 
all. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Your next race gives you a shot at a 
triple crown alongside your big sister! 
How are you feeling going into it?"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"……Yes. I'll leave behind results just 
like my sister's... no, even greater than 
hers!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, surpass that run...?! Now that's 
something to look forward to!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—I was constantly compared to my sister. 
That is why I wanted to prove my own 
worth.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
........Being someone who "isn't 
extraordinary" is truly painful.
choice_data_list:
(……She's been chained down by that this 
whole time, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind her constant striving for 
perfection... perhaps past expectations 
and feelings of inadequacy are still 
clinging to her.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...? Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes... now I understand. It might not be 
entirely flawless, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know all too well what it looks like to 
have a devoted, pure heart that chases a 
childhood dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I know her resilience—how she did 
everything she could on her own for her 
dream, and overcame heartbreak.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
choice_data_list:
So, you can have more confidence in 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her radiance will become a light guiding 
the team…… and bring not just one, but 
countless victories. This dream will 
surely――
choice_data_list:
Because you're the only one who can make 
it come true.

Because you're the only one who can make 
it come true.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...Am I... the only one...?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ........Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...I can't stay down forever. I need to 
lead the team—to their dreams.
choice_data_list: Yeah. That's Casino Drive for you.
Yeah. That's Casino Drive for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—An early afternoon bathed in sunlight. 
Those gleaming eyes gazed straight ahead.
